quest.title: Adventure Takes Courage!
quest.description: Patchi is near the Thousand Winds Temple, trying to find a way to enter...

dialogues.speaker: Patchi the Curious
dialogues.text: There's no such THING as a perfect plan when you're on an adventure! How are you going to make any progress at all if you keep deliberating like this?

dialogues.speaker: Doolan
dialogues.text: If the plan isn't perfect, then we need to be prepared for anything!

dialogues.speaker: Patchi the Curious
dialogues.text: I am a researcher of ancient ruins, and I wish to embark on a field trip to the Thousand Winds Temple. But I don't deal well with situations involving combat.

dialogues.speaker: Patchi the Curious
dialogues.text: Mr. Doolan here is an adventurer, and has taken it upon himself to make all the necessary arrangements for the temple investigation.

dialogues.speaker: Patchi the Curious
dialogues.text: Now, I do not mean to be critical of Doolan in any way, and I know that those Ruin Guards can be a real nuisance... but he insists on devising a fully comprehensive adventure plan down to the last detail, to which end he calls meeting after meeting...

dialogues.speaker: Patchi the Curious
dialogues.text: We've had research, investigation, and amendments, followed by supplementary research, further investigation, and round-two amendments... Ahh, I just can't take it anymore!

dialogues.speaker: Patchi the Curious
dialogues.text: Now he says he's found new evidence of monsters camping out next to the temple.

dialogues.speaker: Patchi the Curious
dialogues.text: I'm begging you, clear them out for me, would you? Just to shut him up, even if it doesn't get us inside the temple...

choices.text: I think I understand what needs to happen...
I'll happily take your place at Doolan's meetings.

response.speaker: Patchi the Curious
response.text: I appreciate the gesture, but take it from me...

response.speaker: Patchi the Curious
response.text: ...You'll find those monsters far less stressful to deal with than one of his meetings!

dialogues.speaker: Patchi the Curious
dialogues.text: So, have you wiped out the monsters' camps?

dialogues.speaker: Patchi the Curious
dialogues.text: Please do it as soon as you can. Before Doolan finds yet another piece of evidence to pursue and ponder...

dialogues.speaker: Patchi the Curious
dialogues.text: Have you wiped out the monsters' camps yet?

dialogues.speaker: Patchi the Curious
dialogues.text: Wonderful. I will speak with him at once about a proposed means of entry into the temple.

dialogues.speaker: Patchi the Curious
dialogues.text: He'll have no excuse to pull me into a meeting this time!
